svg.title: Draw it: the tail, and what one number hid
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw the twelve latencies as a row of dots on one axis with the mean, the p50, the p95 and the max all marked and named, draw the subgroup table as two bars of very different heights each carrying its own n, and write the one sentence that says what the overall number was hiding.
svg.text: Draw it: the tail, and what one number hid
1. the twelve latencies as dots on one axis — NAME the mean, p50, p95 and max
2. the two subgroups as bars of very different heights, each with its own n
3. one sentence in your handwriting: what the overall number hid, with both numbers
